requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Seoyun, are you still at work?"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Yeah ㅠㅠ The meeting won't end. Jiwoo, did you get off work already?"}, {"id": 2, "text": "Just left. By the way, did the contract go through okay?"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Yeah, I signed it yesterday. It's really over now."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Huh, only three days left?"}, {"id": 2, "text": "Right, ㅠㅠ there's so much to do."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Did you book a full-service moving company?"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Nope lol. Semi-packing. We're moving on Saturday, so I have to pack everything myself."}, {"id": 2, "text": "What about the cat? Moving day's gonna be chaos."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "I'm boarding Boree at a pet hotel on Saturday. The booking form asked for an English name, so I wrote Barley lol"}, {"id": 1, "text": "lol lol lol I always mix up whether Boree is a boy or a girl"}, {"id": 2, "text": "She's a girl. She's three and still shy with strangers"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Rest up on Sunday once the move is done. I want to see Bori too lol. Want to get brunch?"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Sounds good! Hyejin unnie said she'd come over to help me sort things out on Sunday."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Oh nice. So Bori will be at the house that day too?"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Yeah, my brother says he'll drop her off Sunday morning"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Good thing. Should I invite Subin too? ◆"}, {"id": 2, "text": "I asked, and Subin can't come on Sunday. Apparently she has plans already"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Too bad. Oh, how do you spell the English name of the new hire Chaeyul? I need to send the calendar invite."}, {"id": 1, "text": "She said to write it as Chaeyul. Not 'Chaeyool' lol"}, {"id": 2, "text": "Okay. What are you going to do about the sofa? Bori always slept there, didn't she?"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "I posted it on Danggeun and someone contacted me right away. We agreed to do an in-person pickup tomorrow evening."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Oh, that was fast. Seoyun, you really treasured that sofa, didn't you?"}, {"id": 2, "text": "Yeah ㅠㅠ But the new place is small, so there's no other choice."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Did you get your deposit back from the old place? The landlady was pretty strict, right?"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Not yet ㅠㅠ She said I have to clean it properly, so I have to scrub everything before Sunday."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Wait, Sunday is supposed to be your day off. Let's make Chaeyul do it ㅋㅋ"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Right. They said they'll return the deposit right after the inspection."}, {"id": 1, "text": "My older brother used to work at a moving company. Want me to ask him for tips?"}, {"id": 2, "text": "Oh really? Does he still do it?"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "No, he quit last year and now runs a café. But he'll still tell you some tips."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Thanks lol. Jiwoo, did you send the Monday meeting invite to Chaeyul too?"}, {"id": 2, "text": "Yeah, I just sent it. By the way, is Bori okay with riding in the car?"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "She runs away the moment she sees the carrier, lol. I have to lure her out with treats."}]}
